historical_base: 341 reused research fixtures, both seasons GW22-38; not pristine holdout
time_scope: Feature prefixes and GK estimator training filtered before each origin. Fixed selected NP head was fit on 2025/26 GW16-21: 2024/25 is nonchronological conditional robustness. Other selected-head fit clocks must be inventoried; no independent forecast-accuracy claim.
baseline: Existing B architecture: corrected physical features, sole-GK policy with prefix-only fitting, selected NP head, physical timeline and conserved B events. All original model code unchanged.
oracle_sample: Up to 24 eligible fixtures per season, evenly spaced in (GW,fixture UUID) order; no residual-based selection
oracle_minutes: Actual FPL scoring minutes preserved exactly. A distinct physical clock is minimally reconciled to legal paired substitutions and <=3 windows. M alone infers starting XI by observed duration then pregame p ties; M+S uses actual starters. This reflects information overlap and is not a posterior of the B role mixture. Clock reconstruction is not observed substitution timing.
oracle_starters: Actual XI fixed; unchanged B conditional durations and event law
oracle_goals: Exact total-score conditioning of independent Bernoulli own goals plus Poisson ordinary/penalty success processes; misses independently thinned. Never Poisson(lambda=actual goals).
oracle_exclusions: Red-card removal, missing positive-participation roster, >5 observed substitutions/other infeasible normal-match coverage; reasons and raw-vs-reconciled clock coverage retained
interaction: All 8 masks on identical cohort. Report factorial interactions and loss-based Shapley contributions; never add separate marginal oracle gains.
CRN: Oracle timeline and event RNG reset separately per fixture/rep/draw. Common stream starts where possible; score conditioning consumes a different sequence so this is not full eventwise CRN. Empirical seed uncertainty reported separately.
MC_cases: All 10 current GW10 fixtures plus first UUID fixture at GW24 and GW32 in each historical season; Penders and Le Fee current included
MC_pairing: Nested draw prefixes within each independent seed; read-only collector consumes no RNG
MM_groups: Pregame position, club, p>=.90 regular, .20<=p<.90 rotation, p<.20 reserve, known injury/return, >=180 minutes/7d high load, verified non-PL/UEFA subset. Overlapping diagnostic groups must not be summed. National-team workload unavailable unless source is established.
TS: Realistic model-managed historical states from prior-origin forecasts/prices; bounded exact <=2-transfer universe and legal XI/bench/C/VC. No invented human history. No stitching later-origin forecasts into a six-GW prediction at an earlier cutoff. Mark full six-GW replay unavailable if true origin-target forecasts/prices/bank provenance missing.
uncertainty: Fixture-cluster bootstrap; retain matched seeds. Monte Carlo SE and between-fixture uncertainty separately reported. Rare subgroup estimates flagged, not tuned.
prospective: Capture full sealed GW10-15 forecast strictly before deadline, append-only SHA-linked manifest and CI artifact; no outcome retrofill or overwriting. Freeze evaluation definitions now.
priority_rubric: Potential accuracy gain x evidence strength / implementation complexity. Oracle effects are diagnostic ceilings, not promises of achievable improvement; unknown expected gains remain unknown. Complexity and evidence ratings are disclosed judgment, not tuned model parameters.
